_doc: docs/compatibility.md (wire fixtures, 0.73.1). The standard agents whose request bodies are replayed against the server under test. The standard agents are written by the server that installed them, so a tag is here when it changed what an agent sends, or is a supported release. Removing one is a support decision: move it to `retired` with the date and the reason, never just delete it.

windows.what: the standard (PowerShell) Windows agent: the installer's Register function, retry-enroll.ps1, and heartbeat.ps1 (the Rem0teHeartbeat task)

tags.why: the oldest standard heartbeat kept: 0.42 added the removal kind to the software inventory
0.51 changed the standard heartbeat (the retireStandard hand-over)
0.68 changed the heartbeat (first inventory without waiting); the previous supported release
the last release before 0.72 changed the heartbeat (the MSA poll hook, inert on the standard agent)
the latest tagged release; carries 0.72's heartbeat change

linux.what: the standard Linux agent (rem0te-agent, the systemd timer) and the Linux installer's registration

tags.why: 0.33 moved the agent onto the shared POSIX fragments, unchanged since
the production release (2026-11-19); no Linux computer is enrolled there, kept for the support window

macos.what: the standard macOS agent (rem0te-agent, the LaunchDaemon) and the macOS installer's registration

tags.why: the production release (2026-11-19); no Mac is enrolled there, kept for the support window
